why: This is a study-specific SEM adaptation of Uses and Gratifications Theory for AR e-learning experience, not a general theory of how people learn or are taught.
UG-STAT is a named, validated assessment instrument used within a specific thoracic-ultrasound competence pathway, rather than a new general instructional element.
name: UG-STAT (ultrasound-guided thoracentesis skills and tasks assessment test)
product_description: UG-STAT is a 100-point, 11-domain formative and summative thoracic-ultrasound skills assessment used by trained assessors in the Thoracic Society of Australia and New Zealand competence pathway.
